# Official reference regression fixtures

Downloaded on 2026-10-07 from the exact official URLs recorded in sources.json. These unmodified HTML snapshots cover the current server-rendered LangChain family reference layout. They are test data, not executable code or instructions. Tests run without fetching these pages and do not execute their examples.

The snapshots intentionally retain streamed HTML markup so parser regressions reflect the actual pages. They do not establish compatibility with installed package versions. LangSmith traceable has no example block in this snapshot.
